messages:
elaine: Quick a11y lab dump from yesterday's console pass — ran contrast, keyboard nav, and a short VoiceOver/NVDA sweep on Dashboard and Activity widgets. main takeaways: 3 items that need quick fixes before next release.

aj: awesome, thanks. can you list the failing pairs + repro steps?

elaine: sure — pasted below. kept it short.
1) Primary CTA contrast (small labels) — fail. example: `#2563FF` on white (Label text 12px/500) measured ~2.7:1. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for normal text.
   repro: open Dashboard -> card header with CTA in compact mode -> zoom to 100%

2) Focus ring low-visibility in dark mode on buttons/links — appears as `rgba(37,90,255,0.45)` at 1px. On near-black surfaces it barely shows. Keyboard users reported losing focus when tabbing across dense tables.
   repro: Settings > Model routes table. tab through rows quickly.

3) ARIA labels for collapsible sections — screen reader announces just "button" for some toggles; missing `aria-expanded` sync on animate collapse. VoiceOver readout not helpful.
   repro: Console left nav -> expand "Models" -> toggle sections rapidly

mira: thanks, good catches. for (1) do we want to shift CTA color or adjust text weight/size?

elaine: recommend making text meet contrast first. options:
- change text to #0B1A33 (darken to meet 4.5:1) OR
- keep #2563FF but increase size/weight to 14px 600 for compact labels (still prefer color change).

aj: prefer color change for consistency with tokens. if we can pick new token value that keeps brand vibrancy while passing. can you propose 2 token candidates?

elaine: proposing token `--brand-cta-strong: #154BD6` (passes 4.6:1 on white) and fallback `--brand-cta-dark: #0B2B66` (passes 7.1:1).

jamal: sharing quick CSS snippet for focus ring improvement, tested locally:
```css
:focus {
  outline: 3px solid rgba(21,75,214,0.9); /* stronger ring */
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
```
adds clearer visibility on dark bg. think 3px is fine for dense tables — requests UX signoff.

mira: 3px seems big for some compact buttons, could we use 2px on small controls and 3px for content-rich interactive elements?

aj: yeah prefer scaled approach. also consider using box-shadow ring on <button> while keeping links thinner.

elaine: noted. i'll update the tokens + PR. also for (3) ARIA: we need to ensure toggles have `role="button"`, `aria-expanded` set, and add `aria-controls` pointing to panel id. animate collapse should toggle `aria-hidden` on the panel. small patch — non-blocking but messes with SR flow.

jamal: quick NVDA note — when collapse animation runs longer than 250ms NVDA sometimes reads stale content. so keep animation under 200ms or use `prefers-reduced-motion` to skip.

mira: good call. add `prefers-reduced-motion` rule and force instant collapse for SR.

a11y-bot: Reminder: run axe-ci on CI for `design/console` routes after PR. failing rules to watch: color-contrast, focus-order, aria-allowed-attr.

aj: timeline? can this be patch in this sprint?

elaine: i'll send a small PR with token tweak + focus CSS + aria attributes today, aiming to land tomorrow. will add screenshots for before/after and VoiceOver notes.

mira: thanks! once PR is up i'll run a quick keyboard smoke test and NVDA check.

aj: if anyone needs me to pick colors, ping. i'll also update the token docs. :thumbsup:

elaine: cool — pushing branch `fix/a11y-contrast-focus-1719` now. will link when ready.

jamal: small nit — update the console color token name to `--brand-cta-on-white` so it's explicit.

elaine: will do. final note: prioritized fix for release cut is the contrast token + focus ring change. ARIA collapse can follow if we need a tiny rollback path.

mira: agree. thanks team — solid lab. :sparkles:
